notes.decision: Page numeral preserved exactly as transcribed. Standard Coptic numerology gives ⲡ̅=80, ⲛ̅=50, ⲍ̅=7 (sum 137); the user-provided page is 187. Discrepancy may reflect editorial sequencing vs. manuscript foliation. Form retained verbatim.

ⲡⲣⲁⲓ̈ rendered 'kings' (Lyc plural, in accumulated vocabulary); ⲛⲁⲛⲭⲱⲭ rendered 'wellsprings' per accumulated tentative gloss (ⲡⲁⲛⲭⲱⲭ 'wellspring/source'). The pair functions as a fixed doublet on this page (recurring lines 6, 11, 23-24) for political-spiritual elites of a region.

ⲉⲛⲉ here read as the irrealis-conditional particle 'were it not / if not,' setting up the counterfactual continuing through lines 7-10: 'were it not for the Father's strength, they would not have left me one day in Babylon.' Fits the autobiographical apologia structure.

Translated 'for service under the kings.' ⲉϩⲃ̅ taken as ⲉ- + ϩⲃⲁ 'service, work-state,' rendering the imperial-administrative carrying-capacity image. Alternative readings include 'in subjection under' (ϩⲃⲁ as 'subjection') or '(power) of work under.' All preserve the sense that the Assyrian land sustains the imperial structure.

Rendered 'it has not been turned (aside)' — ⲅⲱⲧⲡ̅ taken as Lyc reflex of a verb of overturning/turning aside (cf. ⲕⲱⲧⲡ̄/ϭⲱⲧⲡ̄ 'turn aside,' or related to ϫⲱⲧⲡ̄ 'gather, be set upon'). Paired with preceding ⲡⲓϥⲕⲓⲙ 'it did not move' as a doublet for the kingdom's immovability before its enemies.

Rendered 'this laying-bare of heart' to preserve the literal sense of ⲕⲱⲕ (in glossary ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ 'strip naked'); ⲕⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ literally 'stripping/laying-bare of heart' = openness, candidness. Distinct from but semantically related to ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ 'purpose of heart' in glossary; possibly a Lyc variant. The image fits Mani's testimony that the Medes/Parthians responded with sincere disclosure.

Read as negative perfect 3sg.m: 'But he himself did not find likewise to receive him.' Subject-referent ambiguous; likely the cosmic Adversary (Errant/Sin) who was unable to seize Mani because the power of truth moved everything. Alternative: 'his (Mani's) finding likewise to receive him,' a participial reading. Negative reading taken as default given parallelism with positive ⲁϩⲅⲛⲅⲙ̅ 'they found' in line 23.

ⲛⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ here functions as 'the manner / the form,' likely Lyc variant or related to ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'likeness.' With ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ 'whole' and ⲙⲡⲥⲙⲁⲧ 'of the form,' the phrase suggests universal correspondential transformation. Translated 'at the entire manner of the form.'

Coptic preserved as transcribed; treated as scribal abbreviation/typo for ⲡⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ 'the Apostle.' Translated 'the Apostle' since the discourse-formula 'Then said the Apostle to the disciple' is the standard Kephalaia frame.

Rendered 'I am one Anointed' — ⲡⲙⲛ̄ⲭⲥ per glossary = 'the Anointed/the Christ.' Translation 'one Anointed' preserves the unity-uniqueness emphasis (Mani as unique apostolic Christ-figure, not 'a Christ among others'). With ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ 'single, sole.'

Rendered 'wickedness' tentatively. Etymology unclear: possibly Lyc abstract on ⲃⲱⲱⲛ 'wicked' (with phonological shift) or related to ⲃⲏϫⲉ/ⲃⲏⲍⲉ 'lack/deficiency.' Context (paired with ⲇⲁⲙⲁⲍⲉ 'subdue' applied to dark powers) supports a moral-defective sense. Confidence low; flagged for parallels.
